subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio attachments to the core read-tool contract, and what provider-egress, fallback, config, and session/audit policy should govern that raw-media path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but solving it changes core content types, provider serialization, sensitive media egress, and transcript/replay semantics that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Design the native-audio contract first
options.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, explicit raw-media egress, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

options.title: Keep read audio transcription-only for now
options.body: Leave raw audio out of the read tool and direct users to existing media-understanding transcription paths until policy is settled.

options.title: Fold into the broader native-audio tracker
options.body: Treat this read-tool request as a subcase of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51667 if maintainers want one native-audio design thread.

recommendation.title: Design the native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, explicit raw-media egress, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current provenance across the read-tool, LLM content, and media/provider contract paths this decision would change.
